"Be silent before the Lord God! For the day of the Lord is near." How do you prepare your heart for God?
Some said in their hearts, "The Lord will not do good, nor will he do ill." How can we become complacent about God?
"Seek the Lord, all you humble of the land... seek righteousness; seek humility." What does seeking humility look like?
People from every coastland will bow down to the Lord. What does this show about God's plan for the nations?
God will change the speech of the peoples so they may call on the name of the Lord. What does this show about God's plan?
"They shall seek refuge in the name of the Lord." What does God's name mean to you?
"The Lord your God is in your midst... he will rejoice over you with gladness; he will quiet you by his love; he will exult over you with loud singing." How does it feel that God sings over you?
